wrk3-gate.description: Run the full Go verification gate (build, vet, test).
wrk3-gate.template: Run `go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... -count=1` in the worktree root and report the result. On failure, cite file:line evidence.

wrk3-skill.description: Preview the bundled wrk3 agent setup guide.
wrk3-skill.template: Run `go run . skill` in the wrk3 repo and show the output.

wrk3-status.description: Validate the example wrk3 config with status.
wrk3-status.template: Run `go run . -f ./wrk3.yaml.example status` in the wrk3 repo and report the worktree table.

wrk3-test.description: Run a focused subset of Go tests by -run pattern (empty = full gate).
wrk3-test.template: In the worktree root, if $ARGUMENTS is empty run the full gate (`go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... -count=1`); otherwise run `go vet ./cmd/ && go test ./cmd/ -run '$ARGUMENTS' -count=1`. Report the result, citing file:line evidence on failure.

wrk3-checks.description: Watch a PR's CI checks until they complete, then report pass/fail.
wrk3-checks.template: Poll `gh pr checks $ARGUMENTS` (empty $ARGUMENTS means the current branch's PR) roughly every 30 seconds until no check is pending, queued, or in progress. Then report each check as pass/fail with its run URL. If any check fails, also run `gh pr view $ARGUMENTS --json state,mergeable,mergeStateStatus` and summarize whether the PR is mergeable.
